## Monday

Thirty minutes. What shipped, what is stuck, what needs a decision.

Write the notes on a new page in this collection. If a choice will matter later, also add it to [Decisions](item:decisions).

## No other standing meetings

Questions that need a paragraph go on a page. Questions that need a sentence stay in chat.
